expectations.text: Recommends sparse MaxDiff (not full design with 75 items)
expectations.evidence: Opening line: '75 items puts you firmly in sparse MaxDiff territory. A full design would require roughly 94 sets per respondent... Nobody finishes that.'

expectations.text: Specifies items-per-respondent-subset, showings-per-item, and sets-per-respondent with actual numbers
expectations.evidence: Summary table explicitly shows: Items per respondent = 24, Sets per respondent = 18, Showings per item per respondent = 3. Step 3 derives all three with math.

expectations.text: Discusses co-occurrence balance across the population
expectations.evidence: Step 4: 'every pair of items should co-occur in at least 2-3 respondents sets across the population... accept the design only if the minimum pairwise co-occurrence count is >= 2 at your target sample size.'

expectations.text: Gives sample size in the 500-1500 range with reasoning (not just a rule-of-thumb)
expectations.evidence: Derives SE formula, provides table, recommends n=800 with explicit derivation: ~768 pop showings per item -> ~4.3 pt SE on 0-100 scale.

expectations.text: Notes individual-level readout degrades at k=75 and recommends aggregate or segment-level
expectations.evidence: Step 3: fewer than 3 showings per item per respondent = extrapolating from group mean. Execution: items 30-50 are statistically indistinguishable band; report by significance groupings not strict rank order.

eval_feedback.overall: No suggestions. All assertions pass cleanly.
